reason: My staff already know our POS and card terminal, and half my summer guests are tourists who come once, so a loyalty loop and guest offers do little for them. I'm not adding a second system and an extra payment fee for that.
objection: Will my guests really pay by QR instead of handing over a card or cash? If they don't, I pay 59 GEL plus fees for a system nobody uses, and my waiters have one more thing to explain.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing a similar Tbilisi restaurant where most tables actually paid by QR, with no extra work for the staff and the payment fee no higher than my card terminal's.
